1238-3861-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
1238-3861-8323-8324.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

4289-4742-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1011-2728-4153-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-4153-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-4153-5231.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

4067-5078-6747-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3789-3899-4552-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-7052-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7052-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2523-2869-4865.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Vesuvan Shapeshifter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Vesuvan Shapeshifter that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Vesuvan Shapeshifter token instead.
2523-2869-4865.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

2232-2459-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-2459-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Treasures.
2232-2459-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Rograkh by paying its mana cost.
When Rograkh enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-2459-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7509.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
5231-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4377-5531-5900.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
4377-5531-5900.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using Lilysplash Mentor.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

147-5188-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5188-5231.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6753-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
997-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2440-3480-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3480-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

480-6798-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

862-2173-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4508-4875-6310.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Pirate" chosen.
4508-4875-6310.description:
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.
4508-4875-6310.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

1479-1671-5361.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1350-1778-2757-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Plains.
1350-1778-2757-5705.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Memnite, untapping the Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Plains.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-3113-3523.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3113-3523.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

802-1980-2493-3661-5326.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
802-1980-2493-3661-5326.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Archaeomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting The Master.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ornithopter.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning The Master to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

526-1090-3280.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken non-Angel creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1090-3280.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel that is a 1/1 Frog.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Angel you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Restoration Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.

1543-3263-3666-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Nissa has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1543-3263-3666-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Nissa.
Activate Nissa by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3677-4552-4944.description:
Activate Mishra's Factory's second ability by paying {0}, causing it to become a 2/2 Assembly-Worker creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Mishra's Factory's second ability by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

2048-2104-2707.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

676-2100-5195.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creature tokens.
676-2100-5195.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

668-3858.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power nine or greater.
668-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and gain ten life.
Activate Willowdusk by paying {1} and tapping it, putting ten +1/+1 counters on a creature you control with power ten or greater.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

366-1000-2567.manaNeeded: {5}{G}{G}{U}, plus an additional {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
366-1000-2567.description:
Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering its ability and Purphoros.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Avenger of Zendikar.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar for each land you control.
Each Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities and Purphoros that many times.
Resolve an Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
The Plants enter the battlefield, triggering Purphoros that many times, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each Plant that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve all remaining Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each trigger.

91-1656-3693-4050.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Necrotic Ooze undying until end of turn.
If Necrotic Ooze has any +1/+1 counters, activate it using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 2 until Necrotic Ooze has no +1/+1 counters.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Necrotic Ooze, adding {B}.
Necrotic Ooze dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4455.notablePrerequisites:
Ghost Lantern attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3490-4455.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Ghost Lantern, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of counters on the creature with Ghost Lantern attached, you may activate its equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to any other creature you control to get infinite +1/+1 counters on all creatures you control.

971-4222-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vorel.
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
4 charge counters on Pentad Prism.
971-4222-4312.description:
Pay {U}{G} and tap Vorel, doubling the number of charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Remove 3 charge counters from Pentad Prism to add {U}{U}{G}.
Pay {U} to untap Vorel.
Repeat.

228-1580-4277.notablePrerequisites: At least one card in hand or
228-1580-4277.description:
Equip Skullclamp to Reassembling Skeleton.
Reassembling Skeleton dies drawing you 2 cards.
Exile both cards from your hand to gain {2}{B}{B}.
Return Reassembling Skeleton to the battlefield with its ability.
Repeat.

3201-3525-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
3201-3525-4644.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
